desc: Offline package and boot-path audit for the daily root's regulatory database. Grounding: ticket 307 observed that /lib/firmware/regulatory.db and its signature are absent and that country 00 limits 5-GHz active scanning; ROADMAP §E requires integration/regression coverage while WiFi is otherwise functional. Produce a reproducible wireless-regdb packaging change or manifest for both the initramfs probe-time firmware set and the post-switch-root image, verify regulatory.db plus regulatory.db.p7s hashes/permissions and kernel firmware-loader lookup order, and add host-only negative tests for missing or mismatched pairs. Preserve the established c2-under-c0 BCM4388 mapping and make no claim that this fixes the separately observed 2.4-GHz blind band; that remains ticket 307's later diagnosis. No rig, radio interaction, network change, firmware write, or enrollment.
author: terra
